context_requirements: Active caspase-dependent apoptosis or inflammatory caspase signaling at the time of treatment
Expression of the targeted caspase(s) in the relevant cell type
A stimulus that engages caspase activity; unstimulated monolayer cultures are unlikely to respond
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines
Induction of apoptosis or stress signatures (e.g., CASP3, CASP7, PMAIP1, BAX, GADD45A) after treatment
Differential viability or transcriptional response across cell lines correlating with caspase expression
